turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I finally finished that sci-fi reading list you suggested last week.
Glad to hear it, Alan. Did any of them stand out in particular?
Yeah, I re-read "Proof" by Isaac Asimov. It's a short story about a mathematician who proves that P equals NP, which is wild to think about given the current state of AI.
That is a classic. It really captures the tension between pure mathematics and practical application. Did you manage to fix that syntax error in your Python script while reading?
Haha, no, I put that off. The dinner reservation for Sarah's birthday is more pressing. Is 7 PM at that new Italian place still okay?
Yes, the reservation is confirmed for 7 PM. I can remind you at 6:30 if you like.
That would be great. Also, did you check if my package from Amazon arrived? I ordered a new HDMI cable.
It shows as delivered to your front porch around 2 PM today. You should be able to pick it up.
